faq.title: Before we begin.
faq.description: Useful answers to the questions that shape a website, CRM or automation engagement.

items.question: What does a website project include?
items.answer: A complete engagement can include strategy, content direction, UX and interface design, responsive development, technical SEO, testing, launch and handover. We agree the exact scope before work begins.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: Timing depends on scope, content and feedback. After the initial review, we provide a practical schedule with clear decision points rather than an arbitrary promise.

items.question: Can you improve an existing website?
items.answer: Yes. We can review the current experience, identify the most valuable improvements and work with what is already useful instead of rebuilding by default.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Nepal?
items.answer: Yes. CodeCraft is based in Nepal and works remotely with businesses worldwide through direct calls, shared reviews and documented decisions.

items.question: What do you need from us to start?
items.answer: Bring the business goal, the current problem and any useful customer context. You do not need a polished brief; defining the right brief is part of the work.

items.question: Can you connect a CRM to our website?
items.answer: Yes. We can map your lead journey, connect forms and enquiries to a CRM, and create a workflow your team can actually maintain.

items.question: What can an AI agent safely handle?
items.answer: A focused agent can answer approved questions, qualify enquiries, collect details, book appointments and hand off to a person when the request needs judgment or care.
